sentences.en: Today, we look at how a derailed train in East Palestine, Ohio, evolved from a local crisis into a national story that has now commanded the attention of both parties in Congress.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来看看俄亥俄州东巴勒斯坦城的一列火车脱轨事故，是如何从一场地方危机演变成全国性事件，并引起国会两党关注的。

sentences.en: My colleague, Emily Cochran, has been reporting from East Palestine, Monday, March 6th.
sentences.zh: 我的同事艾米丽·科克伦一直在3月6日星期一从东巴勒斯坦城发回报道。

sentences.en: Emily, I want to begin this conversation with a little bit of candor, which is that we have struggled here on the show to figure out how to cover the story of this train derailment
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，我想开诚布公地开始这次谈话，那就是我们在节目中一直很纠结该如何报道这起火车脱轨事故，

sentences.en: in East Palestine, Ohio, because it's really been a story dominated by a lot of unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 因为这起发生在俄亥俄州东巴勒斯坦城的事故，确实充斥着大量悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: But that is now starting to change, and the story is moving into the halls of Congress, and that makes you really the perfect person to talk to, because as it happens, as listeners
sentences.zh: 但这种情况现在开始改变，事件正进入国会大厅，这让你成为了最适合谈论此事的人，因为正如听众们

sentences.en: will remember, you're a former congressional reporter for The Times, who has just become a national correspondent, now covering this story in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 所记得的，你是《纽约时报》的前国会记者，刚刚成为全国通讯员，现在正在俄亥俄州报道此事。

sentences.en: So, let's begin with the basics of what exactly happened here.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从这里到底发生了什么的基本情况开始吧。

sentences.en: So, this begins the night of February 3rd, as this nearly two-mile-long train is making
sentences.zh: 事情始于2月3日晚，这列近两英里长的火车正在

sentences.en: its way through Ohio, and it's carrying a bunch of cargo, but most notably some toxic chemicals.
sentences.zh: 穿过俄亥俄州，它载着大量货物，但最引人注目的是一些有毒化学品。

sentences.en: And as the train is progressing, a wheel bearing starts to overheat.
sentences.zh: 当火车行驶时，一个轮轴承开始过热。

sentences.en: So, a sensor records that rising temperature and sounds an alarm on the train.
sentences.zh: 传感器记录下了升高的温度，并向火车发出了警报。

sentences.en: And as soon as the alarm breaches the crew, the crew slows the train down, but that's not enough to stop it from going off the tracks.
sentences.zh: 警报一传到机组人员那里，他们就减慢了车速，但这不足以阻止它脱轨。

sentences.en: And they see fire, they see smoke, they separate their locomotives, the crew is okay, but now
sentences.zh: 他们看到了火光和烟雾，于是将机车分离，机组人员没事，但现在

sentences.en: this train is derailed on the outskirts of a little village called East Palestine in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 这列火车在俄亥俄州一个叫东巴勒斯坦的小村庄郊外脱轨了。

sentences.en: And what do we need to know about this village, East Palestine?
sentences.zh: 关于东巴勒斯坦这个村庄，我们需要了解什么？

sentences.en: It's roughly 4,700 people.
sentences.zh: 它大约有4,700名居民。

sentences.en: It's sort of in the Rust Belt of Ohio, right between Youngstown and Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 它位于俄亥俄州的“铁锈地带”，就在扬斯敦和匹兹堡之间。

sentences.en: And it's a more rural, formerly industrial area, very red Trump country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个更偏向农村、曾经的工业区，是非常坚定的特朗普支持者地区。

sentences.en: They voted overwhelmingly for the former president in 2016 and 2020.
sentences.zh: 他们在2016年和2020年以压倒性优势投票支持了前总统。

sentences.en: But for a lot of people there, it's a place where their families have always lived, and it was a place where they could still afford to have their own farm, own a few acres, and,
sentences.zh: 但对那里许多人来说，这是一个他们的家族世代居住的地方，也是一个他们仍然负担得起拥有自己的农场、几英亩土地，并且，

sentences.en: you know, be close enough to a bigger city if they needed to be, but not be of the big city.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果需要的话，离大城市足够近，但又不必身处大城市之中的地方。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, describe this derailment in this village of East Palestine.
sentences.zh: 那么，请描述一下东巴勒斯坦村的这次脱轨事故。

sentences.en: So, the crew report seeing smoke and fire, and the fire department responds, you know,
sentences.zh: 机组人员报告看到了烟雾和火光，消防部门赶到，你知道，

sentences.en: they try to take care of the fire and try to take care of this train that's now off the tracks.
sentences.zh: 他们试图扑灭火灾，并处理这列已经脱轨的火车。

sentences.en: But over the weekend, it becomes clear that there's a serious problem.
sentences.zh: 但到了周末，情况变得明朗起来，这是一个严重的问题。

sentences.en: Some of the toxic chemicals in the cargo are at risk of exploding.
sentences.zh: 货物中的一些有毒化学品有爆炸的风险。

sentences.en: And one of the chemicals people are the most worried about is called vinyl chloride.
sentences.zh: 人们最担心的一种化学品叫做氯乙烯。

sentences.en: But it's a colorless gas used in a lot of plastics, and it can be really toxic.
sentences.zh: 它是一种无色气体，用于制造许多塑料，毒性可能非常大。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, railroad officials, government officials, the governors of Ohio and Pennsylvania, which shows you how close this was to the border of the two states, you know, they're on the
sentences.zh: 所以，铁路官员、政府官员、俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州的州长——这显示了它离两州边界有多近——你知道，他们在周末

sentences.en: phone over the weekend.

sentences.en: And they've since described it as two bad options.
sentences.zh: 他们后来将其描述为两个糟糕的选择。

sentences.en: Either you wait it out.

sentences.en: There's an explosion that could send shrapnel and all sorts of things across the area, or you do a controlled chemical burn.
sentences.zh: 可能会发生爆炸，将弹片和各种东西散布到整个区域，要么进行受控的化学品燃烧。

sentences.en: And the railroad's preference is to do the chemical burn, and ultimately, the governors and local officials decide to go with it.
sentences.zh: 铁路公司的首选是进行化学品燃烧，最终，州长和地方官员决定采纳这个方案。

sentences.en: And for those of us who don't know, what exactly is a controlled burn?
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些外行，到底什么是受控燃烧？

sentences.en: So, essentially, the plan is to puncture the cars that were carrying these chemicals, drain out the chemicals, and burn them off.
sentences.zh: 本质上，计划是刺穿载有这些化学品的车厢，排出化学品，然后将它们烧掉。

sentences.en: So, before doing that, they make a point of evacuating folks within a mile radius.
sentences.zh: 所以，在做这件事之前，他们特意疏散了一英里半径内的人员。

sentences.en: Sheriffs and other police officials are going door-to-door knocking, saying, you need to get out.
sentences.zh: 警长和其他警务人员挨家挨户敲门，说，你们必须离开。

sentences.en: You know, this is a life-or-death scenario because we're going to burn off these chemicals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个生死攸关的情况，因为我们要烧掉这些化学品。

sentences.en: And officials go ahead with what they had promised.
sentences.zh: 官员们继续执行了他们承诺的计划。

sentences.en: They begin this controlled burn of the chemical cargo.
sentences.zh: 他们开始了化学货物的受控燃烧。

sentences.en: But the consequence of that is that it sets off this giant, terrifying-looking black plume of smoke that not only covers the evacuation zone, but it blankets the region.
sentences.zh: 但后果是，它引发了一团巨大、看起来很恐怖的黑烟，不仅覆盖了疏散区，还笼罩了整个地区。

sentences.en: You know, there are farms in Pennsylvania that are now unable to see their neighbors across the way because the smoke is so thick.
sentences.zh: 你知道，宾夕法尼亚州的一些农场现在甚至看不见对面的邻居，因为烟雾太浓了。

sentences.en: And these stunning images of this giant plume over this small town, this is the moment where a lot more people start paying attention.
sentences.zh: 这些小镇上空巨大烟云的惊人画面，是让更多人开始关注的时刻。

sentences.en: And a lot more people suddenly have questions, not just about the derailment and the consequences
sentences.zh: 更多人突然有了疑问，不仅是关于脱轨事故及其后果，

sentences.en: of a train with toxic cargo going off the tracks, but the consequences of this plume of chemicals across the area.
sentences.zh: 关于一列载有有毒货物的火车脱轨，还有这团化学烟云对整个地区的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the moment when I think a lot of us started to pay attention to this story because we're watching this black plume of smoke on social media.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们许多人开始关注这个故事的时刻，因为我们在社交媒体上看到了那团黑烟。

sentences.en: But at the time, we're being told, as are people in this town, that this is what the company thinks is the best and safest course, and local officials have signed off on it.
sentences.zh: 但当时，我们和镇上的人一样，被告知这是公司认为最好、最安全的做法，地方官员也已经签字同意了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I think what happens now as a result of that plume is that this is no longer about a train derailment.
sentences.zh: 但我认为现在那团烟云带来的结果是，这不再仅仅是一起火车脱轨事故。

sentences.en: It's also about the lasting consequences of burning off toxic chemicals on the outskirts of a small village and what that means for living in this region long term.
sentences.zh: 它还关乎在一个小村庄郊外燃烧有毒化学品的持久后果，以及这对该地区长期居住意味着什么。

sentences.en: So government officials start testing the soil, testing the water, and testing the air quality.
sentences.zh: 因此，政府官员开始检测土壤、水质和空气质量。

sentences.en: And all the tests have so far shown that there's not significant amounts of vinyl chloride, one
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，所有的测试都显示没有显著含量的氯乙烯，这是

sentences.en: of the most prominent of the toxic chemicals in this cargo, the one that folks were really concerned about because that could potentially have long-term health impacts.
sentences.zh: 货物中最主要的一种有毒化学品，也是人们真正担心的那种，因为它可能具有长期的健康影响。

sentences.en: The tests have so far not shown significant amounts, but for the people in that town, it's hard to reconcile those results when there's a bunch of dead fish in the creeks that run

sentences.en: through their neighborhood.

sentences.en: It's hard to reconcile those results when people are suddenly reporting migraines and rashes and other ailments that just didn't occur before the chemical burn.

sentences.en: And, you know, they also point to the fact that under former President Trump, you saw a lot of safety and environmental regulations rolled back.
sentences.zh: 他们认为前总统的政策并没有采取任何措施来阻止这种情况发生。

sentences.en: His administration was anti-regulation and pro-industry every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们说这可能让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: And they argue that the former president's policies didn't do anything to stop this from happening.
sentences.zh: 所以对于这些来到镇上的保守派领导人来说，这现在是一个关于民主党忽视俄亥俄州蓝领阶层的故事。

sentences.en: And in fact, they say it could have made it worse.
sentences.zh: 在某种意义上，他们试图为了政治利益而煽动对那团烟云的恐惧。

sentences.en: So to these conservative leaders who are coming to town, this is now a story of Democratic neglect for working-class Ohioans.
sentences.zh: 民主党人现身说，不，不，我们没有忘记这个社区。

sentences.en: And in a sense, they're seeking to stoke these fears of that plume for some political benefit.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从事故开始我们就一直在这里。

sentences.en: Democrats are showing up and saying, no, no, we have not forgotten about this community.
sentences.zh: 我们向你们保证一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Actually, we've been here since the start of this accident.
sentences.zh: 是的，这只是又一个例子，在真正的悲剧之上，在一个受伤且充满疑问和焦虑的社区之上，又出现了这种政治风暴。

sentences.en: And we are assuring you that everything is going to be fine.

sentences.en: Yes, it's just another instance where you have this political firestorm on top of a real tragedy and on top of a community that is hurting and has a lot of questions and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是Wynna Liu。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: So, Emily, tell us about this legislation that's emerging from this accident and that, surprisingly, given the political firestorm you just described before the break, somehow
sentences.zh: 那么，艾米丽，给我们讲讲这项从这次事故中衍生出来的立法吧。令人惊讶的是，考虑到你刚才在休息前描述的政治风暴，它居然

sentences.en: involves elected officials from both parties.
sentences.zh: 得到了两党民选官员的参与。

sentences.en: So you have these disagreements about who has forgotten Ohio and who showed up to East
sentences.zh: 你们对谁遗忘了俄亥俄州、谁先赶到东巴勒斯坦有分歧，

sentences.en: Palestine first, who should have been there from the get-go.
sentences.zh: 对谁本该从一开始就在那里也有分歧。

sentences.en: But what both parties can agree on is that there is a common villain here, and that's
sentences.zh: 但两党都能达成共识的是，这里有一个共同的罪魁祸首，那就是

sentences.en: Norfolk Southern, the company that was operating the train that derailed and one of the largest rail companies in the country.
sentences.zh: 诺福克南方铁路公司，也就是运营那列脱轨火车的公司，它是全国最大的铁路公司之一。

sentences.en: And that is at the heart of this first bit of bipartisan legislation you see, regulations and tighter safety rules against the railroads and the railroad company.
sentences.zh: 而这正是你所看到的这项两党初步立法方案的核心，即针对铁路和铁路公司的监管以及更严格的安全规则。

sentences.en: Well, how regulated is a company like Norfolk Southern and the entire freight rail industry up to this point?
sentences.zh: 那么，像诺福克南方铁路公司和整个货运铁路行业到目前为止受到的监管程度如何？

sentences.en: So freight rail is generally considered relatively safe with about a thousand derailments a year.
sentences.zh: 货运铁路通常被认为相对安全，每年大约发生一千起脱轨事故。

sentences.en: You want the number of accidents to be zero, but injuries and deaths aren't that common because of derailments.
sentences.zh: 你当然希望事故数量为零，但由于脱轨导致的伤亡并不常见。

sentences.en: And incidents like this one involving hazardous material are rare.
sentences.zh: 像这次涉及危险材料的事故更是罕见。

sentences.en: But when you look at Norfolk Southern in particular, the rate of accidents has gone up over the last four years.
sentences.zh: 但当你特别审视诺福克南方铁路公司时，会发现过去四年来其事故率一直在上升。

sentences.en: And it comes as the company is reporting record operating profits and spending a lot of money in time lobbying against new rules that are intended to make trains even safer.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，该公司报告了创纪录的营业利润，并投入大量金钱和时间游说反对旨在提高火车安全性的新规。

sentences.en: And you have railroad unions coming off some really contentious battles about their contracts and their protections saying that their workforce has been slashed.
sentences.zh: 铁路工会刚刚经历了一些关于合同和保障的激烈斗争，他们表示员工队伍已经被大幅削减。

sentences.en: There's not enough people or safety precautions being taken to make rails even safer for both
sentences.zh: 没有足够的人手或安全预防措施来让铁路变得更安全，这不仅是为了

sentences.en: the communities these trains are passing through, but also the people who are operating these trains.
sentences.zh: 火车经过的社区，也是为了操作这些火车的人。

sentences.en: So they're making a link between their working conditions and an accident like the one that just happened in East Palestine.
sentences.zh: 所以他们将工作条件与刚刚发生在东巴勒斯坦的事故联系了起来。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's where lawmakers in both parties are seeing an opportunity to do something.
sentences.zh: 这就是两党议员看到采取行动机会的地方。

sentences.en: Well, which lawmakers exactly are we talking about and what exactly are they proposing be done?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们具体指的是哪些议员？他们提出的具体方案是什么？

sentences.en: So you have the four senators whose states are at the heart of this derailment.
sentences.zh: 有四位参议员，他们的州正处于这次脱轨事件的核心。

sentences.en: You have the two Democrats from Pennsylvania, Bob Casey and John Fetterman.
sentences.zh: 有两位来自宾夕法尼亚州的民主党人，鲍勃·凯西和约翰·费特曼。

sentences.en: But then you have the bipartisan delegation from Ohio.
sentences.zh: 还有来自俄亥俄州的两党代表团。

sentences.en: You have J.D.
sentences.zh: 有共和党人J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, who's a Republican, and Sherrod Brown, who's a Democrat facing re-election this midterm cycle.
sentences.zh: 万斯，以及在这个中期选举周期面临连任的民主党人谢罗德·布朗。

sentences.en: And they sign on to this bill along with Marco Rubio, a Republican from Florida, and Josh
sentences.zh: 他们与来自佛罗里达州的共和党人马可·卢比奥，以及来自密苏里州的共和党人乔什·霍利

sentences.en: Hawley, a Republican from Missouri.
sentences.zh: 一起签署了这项法案。

sentences.en: So a decent amount of bipartisan collaboration by today's standards.
sentences.zh: 所以按照今天的标准来看，这算是不错的两党合作了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then another important element here is when Chuck Schumer, the majority leader who controls
sentences.zh: 另一个重要因素是，当控制参议院议程的多数党领袖查克·舒默站出来说，我认为这是一项有价值的立法，我会努力帮助它在参议院通过时，

sentences.en: the Senate floor, comes out and says, I think this is a worthwhile piece of legislation, and I will work to help get it through the Senate.
sentences.zh: 情况就不同了。

sentences.en: I will work to help get those 60 votes you need to advance any piece of legislation.
sentences.zh: 我会努力争取通过任何立法所需的60张选票。

sentences.en: That's a hurdle a lot of legislation just can't meet right now.
sentences.zh: 那是目前许多立法都无法跨越的障碍。

sentences.en: But if it does clear that hurdle, President Biden has said he will sign it.
sentences.zh: 但如果它能跨越这个障碍，拜登总统已经表示他会签署。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So walk us through the key provisions of this bipartisan legislation that's being proposed and how these elements would have applied to this case or could prevent future cases
sentences.zh: 那么请为我们梳理一下这项拟议的两党立法的主要条款，以及这些要素将如何适用于本案，或如何防止未来发生

sentences.en: like it.
sentences.zh: 类似的案件。

sentences.en: So one of the biggest concerns we heard about in the aftermath of this was that the local communities didn't know that the train was carrying these toxic chemicals.
sentences.zh: 我们在事后听到的最大担忧之一是，当地社区不知道火车上载有这些有毒化学品。

sentences.en: The current regulations say if a train is carrying flammable liquids in either 20 consecutive cars or 35 cars total, they have to notify the states they're traveling through.
sentences.zh: 现行法规规定，如果火车在连续20节车厢或总共35节车厢中载有易燃液体，就必须通知所经过的州。

sentences.en: And they also have to meet a whole other round of tougher safety rules.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还必须满足另一整套更严格的安全规则。

sentences.en: But the Ohio train didn't meet that standard, so it didn't need to take those additional precautions.
sentences.zh: 但俄亥俄州的这列火车没有达到那个标准，所以不需要采取那些额外的预防措施。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So the legislation would effectively ensure that any train carrying this kind of cargo would
sentences.zh: 因此，这项立法实际上将确保任何载有此类货物的火车都

sentences.en: have to let the communities know that it was coming through because that was crucial context
sentences.zh: 必须让社区知道它要经过，因为这是急救人员和政府官员在脱轨后立即需要掌握的关键背景信息。

sentences.en: that first responders and government officials would have needed in the immediate aftermath of the derailment.
sentences.zh: 调查人员说，火车车厢的热度非常高，以至于融化了车厢上的塑料标牌，而那些标牌本可以告诉急救人员里面装的是什么。

sentences.en: The heat of the train car, investigators have said, was so high that it melted the plastic placards off of the train car that would have told first responders what was inside.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们收到了通知，那将是额外的一层预防和知识，在这样的脱轨事故发生后至关重要。

sentences.en: So had they had that notice, that would have just been an extra layer of precaution and knowledge that can be pretty critical in the aftermath of a derailment like this.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有意思。

sentences.en: That's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 好的，还有什么？

sentences.en: Okay, what else?
sentences.zh: 你会记得，这次脱轨的核心是一个热轮轴承，一个过热的轮轴承，而机组人员在非常非常晚的时候才收到通知。

sentences.en: So you'll remember that at the heart of this derailment was a hot wheel bearing, an overheating wheel bearing that the crew was notified about very, very late in the game.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以这项立法要做的是，要求对轮轴承等部件

sentences.en: So what the legislation would do is it would require stricter scrutiny of parts like a wheel bearing
sentences.zh: 以及火车车厢的其他元件进行更严格的审查，以确保故障能更早被发现，并加强安全预防措施，避免类似事件再次发生。

sentences.en: and other elements of the train car to ensure that malfunctions are caught earlier and safety precautions are stronger to avoid something like that happening again.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上是加强检查和安全协议。

sentences.en: So basically heightened inspections and safety protocols.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 因此，该措施将真正加强对铁路车厢、

sentences.en: So as a result of that, the measure would really toughen the inspection requirements for rail cars,
sentences.zh: 零部件和铁路探测器的检查要求，以确保不仅在火车上路前采取预防措施，

sentences.en: the parts, and railway detectors just to make sure that not only are there precautions taken
sentences.zh: 而且在故障发生的早期阶段就能发现问题。

sentences.en: before the trains get on the railroad, but it's possible to catch them early on in the process of something malfunctioning.
sentences.zh: 为了真正支持这里对安全性的日益重视，它还将拨出资金

sentences.en: And then to really back up the increased emphasis on safety here, it would also set aside money
sentences.zh: 供联邦机构进行更多的研发，以研究未来如何使罐车更坚固、更安全。

sentences.en: for federal agencies to just do more research and development about how to make tank cars stronger and safer going forward.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，议员们在这样的事故后齐心协力制定立法，这似乎很引人注目，甚至很高尚。

sentences.en: Emily, it seems notable and perhaps even noble for lawmakers to come together after an accident like this and create legislation.
sentences.zh: 但有没有可能，这项立法因为是专门针对东巴勒斯坦发生的事情而制定的，所以实际上只解决了那里发生的问题？

sentences.en: But is it possible that this legislation, because it's been crafted so specifically to speak to what happened in East Palestine, is really only addressing what happened there?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些条款是否应该在范围上更广泛一些？

sentences.en: I mean, should these provisions potentially be wider in scope?
sentences.zh: 或者这实际上是一个相对安全的行业，并不真正需要广泛的新监管？

sentences.en: Or is this in fact a relatively safe industry that doesn't really require broad new regulation?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这里发生的事情，特别是考虑到所涉及的化学品，是一个例外吗？

sentences.en: In other words, is what happened here, especially given the chemicals involved, an exception?
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于一个政府分裂的时代。

sentences.en: We are in an era of divided government now.
sentences.zh: 任何成为法律的法案不仅需要在参议院获得足够的共和党支持，现在还需要赢得共和党控制的众议院的支持。

sentences.en: Any bill that becomes law needs to not only get enough Republican support in the Senate, but now needs to win the support of a Republican-controlled House.
sentences.zh: 我认为，第一，这项立法能否做到这一点尚不清楚。

sentences.en: And I think, one, it's not clear if this legislation can do that.
sentences.zh: 第二，它保证了任何措施都不会像民主党及其盟友，特别是工会所希望的那样走得那么远。

sentences.en: And two, it guarantees that any measure will not go as far as Democrats and their allies, particularly in the unions, want it to go.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们担心这不会是一个例外，特别是在拜登政府希望铁路在美式生活中变得更加突出的时候。

sentences.en: And I think there is a fear that this is not going to be an exception, particularly at a moment
sentences.zh: 他们正在投入更多的资金。

sentences.en: when the Biden administration wants rail to become even more prominent in American life.
sentences.zh: 他们希望它成为这个国家更安全、更大、利用率更高的交通方式。

sentences.en: They're putting a lot more money towards it.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们非常担心，随着火车继续成为交通运输业中更大的一部分，你会看到更多的脱轨事故。

sentences.en: They want it to be a safer, bigger, more utilized aspect of transportation in this country.
sentences.zh: 如果安全预防措施不同时加强，你会看到更多的事故。

sentences.en: And I think there's a lot of fear that as trains continue to become a bigger part of the transportation industry, you will see more derailments.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You will see more accidents if those safety precautions aren't strengthened at the same time.
sentences.zh: 诺福克南方铁路公司呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 它反对这项立法吗？

sentences.en: What about Norfolk Southern?
sentences.zh: 它还没有明确对这项立法发表意见，但现实是该公司正面临来自双方的巨大政治压力。

sentences.en: Is it opposing this legislation?
sentences.zh: 首席执行官准备在参议院作证，我认为那将是议员和公司之间一场相当激烈的对抗。

sentences.en: So it hasn't explicitly weighed in on this legislation yet, but the reality is the company's facing a ton of political pressure from both sides.
sentences.zh: 它在各方面都面临着巨大的压力，不仅要对清理这次事故负责，还要确保它不再发生。

sentences.en: The chief executive is set to testify before the Senate, and I think that'll be a pretty heated confrontation between lawmakers and the company.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's facing a lot of pressure across the board to make sure that it not only takes responsibility for cleaning up this accident, but making sure it doesn't happen again.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定地说，鉴于刚刚发生的事情，这家公司在反对这类立法方面的政治影响力并不处于巅峰状态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾米丽，回到东巴勒斯坦镇本身。

sentences.en: It seems safe to say that this company is not exactly at the peak of its political power to oppose legislation like this, given what just happened.
sentences.zh: 既然华盛顿有这么多活动，既然两党的这么多官员

sentences.en: So, Emily, back to the town of East Palestine itself.
sentences.zh: 都访问了该社区并承诺努力做些什么来弥补这一切，

sentences.en: Now that there's all this activity in Washington, and now that so many officials from both parties
sentences.zh: 你花了这么多时间交谈的当地人现在感觉如何？

sentences.en: have visited the community and committed themselves to trying to do something to make this right,
sentences.zh: 他们感到振奋吗，还是根本没有？

sentences.en: how are the people there that you have spent all this time talking to feeling in this moment?
sentences.zh: 我认为他们很感激这种关注。

sentences.en: Are they heartened or not really at all?
sentences.zh: 但人们非常担心，在某个时候，全国的注意力会从他们的社区移开，

sentences.en: I think they appreciate the attention.
sentences.zh: 而他们将不得不独自面对这些长期的后果和问题。

sentences.en: There's a lot of concern that at some point the national attention is going to move away from their community,
sentences.zh: 我认为现实是，这些恐惧让许多人第一次质疑他们是否还想继续住在东巴勒斯坦及周边地区，

sentences.en: and they're going to be left with these long-term consequences and questions.
sentences.zh: 是否让孩子留在这里是安全的，是否可以把这里当作他们度过余生的家是安全的。

sentences.en: I think the reality is the fears have made a lot of people for the first time question if they want to keep living in East Palestine and the surrounding area,
sentences.zh: 即使对于那些决心坚持到底的人，也就是那些决心留在这里生活的人来说，也存在对持久污名的恐惧。

sentences.en: if it's safe to keep their kids there, if it's safe to make this the home where they spend the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 短期内，这会影响这里的一切。

sentences.en: And then even for the people who are determined to see this through, if you will, who are determined to keep their lives here, there's also a fear about a lasting stigma.
sentences.zh: 没人想来这里。
